root_idea.summary: The root has two principal semantic orientations: liquid flowing or being discharged, and the inner state or apprehension of the mind.
root_idea.development: The liquid-discharge branch includes urine, urination, flowing, melting, and extensions to semen, offspring, and abundance. The mental branch develops into state or condition, care and concern, and what occurs in the heart or mind.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized nominal citation form بَالٌ.

senses.definition: A person's or group's state, condition, case, or affairs.
senses.usage_conditions: In ما بالُ ... it asks about someone's case or state; in أَصْلَحَ بَالَهُمْ it denotes the condition or affairs that are set right. The Quranic occurrences attest this state-or-condition use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To urinate, discharge urine, or stale.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a man, beast, and other animals.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To beget offspring resembling the parent in form and natural disposition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A metaphorical use of the verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In a poetic metaphor of Canopus, to “urinate” in a beverage made from unripe dates, causing it to spoil.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative poetic construction referring to the seasonal rising of Canopus.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The venting or flowing forth of a liquid.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied, for example, to a wine-skin from which liquid runs out.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To melt or dissolve.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported of fat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To urinate at the root or stem of a tree.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A traditional agricultural practice said to increase the abundance of the tree's fruit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause a person or thing to occur to one's mind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested specifically in the expression لَا أُبَاوِلُهُ, “I do not cause him or it to come to mind.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make horses urinate, or to stop them for the purpose of urinating.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with horses and also in a threatening expression about making horses urinate in someone's courtyards.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To desire or require to urinate.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form X use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek or receive urine from another source.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in a poetic expression about receiving the urine of lions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Care, concern, or importance; something regarded as worth caring about.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in expressions such as مَا بَالَيْتُ بِكَذَا, “I did not care about such a thing,” and كُلُّ أَمْرٍ ذِي بَالٍ, an affair of importance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The heart or mind; an idea or affair occurring to one's mind; attention or mental regard.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in expressions such as خَطَرَ بِبَالِي, “it occurred to my mind,” and أَعْطِنِي بَالَكَ, “give me your attention.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: A whale or other very large sea fish.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This sense is identified as a non-Arabic or arabicized word in the lexical evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A spade used for working land planted with seed crops.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized agricultural implement sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Urine; the act or discharge of urinating.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun is originally described as a verbal noun and has the plural أَبْوَالٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The seminal fluid of mules; by comparison, a mirage, and a name for a road in Yemen.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The mirage sense is based on the perceived fruitlessness of mule seminal fluid; the Yemeni road name is a further lexical application.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Cow's milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A metaphorical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Offspring or progeny.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A metaphorical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A large number or multitude.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A metaphorical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A flask or bottle; also a bag or receptacle for mush or perfume.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The container sense is reported as an arabicized term with varying container applications.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An odour or smell.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported usage attributed to a particular authority, with a proposed association to بَلَوْتُهُ, “I smelled or tested it.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: A staff tipped with iron, used by hunters to throw at game.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized hunting implement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small elongated sword.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A usage attributed to popular speech.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The origin or daughter of a man.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical evidence reports variant interpretations, “origin” and “daughter.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mode or manner of urinating.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal-noun formation from بَالَ; as in حَسَنُ البِيلَةِ, “having a good manner of urinating.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person or animal that urinates much.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a man or an animal such as a camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A disease causing excessive or frequent urination.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported especially as a disease of sheep or goats that may continue until death.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wine-skin from which liquid runs out.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative application based on the flow of liquid.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A piece of fat that melts or dissolves quickly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative intensive description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: More frequent in urination than another, conventionally compared with a dog.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the comparative expression أَبْوَلُ مِنْ كَلْبٍ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: More abundant in offspring.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An alternative interpretation of the same comparative expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The place of urination or urinary discharge; the pudendum of a man or woman.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical and locative noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A diuretic or substance that provokes urination.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Much drinking is given as an example of something having this effect.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A urinal or vessel in which one urinates.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A purpose-specific container noun.

cautions: The Quranic form is normalized as بَالٌ and means state, condition, case, or affairs in the supplied occurrences; the physical-urination and other homographic senses are separate Classical Arabic entries.
The large-sea-fish meaning is explicitly described in the lexical evidence as non-Arabic or arabicized.
Historical Quran citation notation in the lexical evidence has not been converted into additional modern verse locations; the listed Quran examples use only the supplied QAC locations.
